chunks: Had truth been subject to their whims, the heavens and the earth and all those within them would have been depraved. In fact, We had sent them their reminder, but they turned away from the reminder.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the universe if divine truth follows human whims?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the stability of the cosmos as a testament to God's consistent truth, contrasting it with the chaos that would ensue if divine law were subject to mutable human whims. The 'Reminder' (Dhikr) is understood not merely as the Quran but as the broader body of divine guidance, including the Ahl al-Bayt, whose rejection by the heedless underscores the theme of spiritual blindness despite clear evidence.
